messages:
noah: Alert: ingress error spike in eu-central, deploybot auto-paused our 14:00 slot. Can we confirm an emergency hold and quick triage plan?

deploy-bot: [automated] paused slot 2026-04-01T14:00Z due to service.edge 5xx rate > threshold. Paused window: 14:00-14:30. Detector: high downstream queue drops.

eve: Confirm hold. Suggest DO_NOT_REQUEUE for the 14:00 slot, pin canary to last-stable tag (v4.0.3), and open a tentative staggered slot later today.

ranjit: Looking at rollout diffs 16: runtime certs hot-reload + a new net-shaper flag `conn-drain-ms` set to 200 recently. Edge pods show increased connection churn when that flag is active. Recommend flipping `conn-drain-ms` back to 0 on canaries immediately.

sre-lead: I'll push the canary-only change: `kubectl patch cm edge-config -n infra -p '{"data":{"conn-drain-ms":"0"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/edge-runtime`. ETA ~8m. Keeping alerts open.

release-coordinator: Pinning now: `releasectl pin --slot 14:00 --version v4.0.3 --reason "incident hold - ingress spike"` and adding note to slot: "paused - DO_NOT_REQUEUE; pinned to v4.0.3". Will create tentative slot at 19:00 with 4m stagger.

noah: Draft customer blurb ready: "We observed elevated request errors in EU-Central. Scheduled releases are paused while engineers investigate. We'll update in 30 minutes or on resolution." Posting to #ops-status and support template.

ranjit: Applied config change on canaries; runtime restarted. Early metric: 5xx down ~48% on canaries within 5m. Monitoring tail latencies and connection resets.

sre-lead: No infra alarms currently. If error-rate doesn't drop to baseline in 30m we consider reverting the last runtime rollout entirely. For now we keep hold and watch.

release-coordinator: Deploybot created tentative slot: 2026-04-01T19:00Z (stagger 4m). Backfill rules: only emergency fixes, security patches, or doc-only changes. Original slot flagged DO_NOT_REQUEUE.

eve: Owners recap: noah = customer comms + calendar update; ranjit = canary config rollback & traces; sre-lead = infra watch & escalate; release-coordinator = pin/note/tentative slot. Check-in in 25m.

noah: Added incident ticket link and postmortem stub to the release notes. Also updated the change log so schedulers won't requeue.

ranjit: Trace links posted; KV-saturation traces show improvement. Error-rate trending better, aggregate down ~35% but not at baseline yet.

sre-lead: Keeping monitoring hooks for 1 hour. If we see a regression during that window we trigger full rollback of the runtime rollout.

release-coordinator: Reminder to teams: do not manually requeue the 14:00 slot. Use the 19:00 tentative slot and follow the stagger. Include incident id in any backfill notes.

noah: Thanks all. Reconvene here in 25 minutes or earlier if anything changes.
